preservedResponsibilities: Actual InputSource Reference/OUString aggregate ownership, cached XLocator SDK, generated SAXException and FastLocatorImpl component now admit genuine XInputStream bytes through XMLFile2UTFConverter. Source copies and ParserData snapshots precede document callbacks; 16KiB reads stop at EOF without closing input. The existing saxes backend receives incrementally decoded UTF8/UTF16/UTF32 or actual RTL legacy-descriptor output without DOM. This backend binding is not a port or certification of native libxml2 encoding aliases, diagnostics or locator positions. Host FastSaxParseError remains an explicit host envelope; only the missing-input SAXException is an actual generated UNO exception. Native parser mutex/thread machinery, complete XFastParser service, unported RTL encodings, allocation unwind/ABI and full package/model/filter/DOCX/XLSX/Worker/UI acceptance remain unverified. Existing file/autosave/recovery behavior is preserved.

Actual UNO/Sequence input regressions cover BOM-free UTF16 and four UCS4 byte orders, malformed scalar/EOF payloads, double-quoted incompatible declarations, recognized unavailable codecs and real strict Shift-JIS errors. Full UTF7 transport conversion also produces short decoded checkpoints and secondary UTF16-looking byte signatures naturally; no Entity chunks or converters are replaced. The original quote asymmetry causes conditional unknown-encoding admission (CALC364/WRITER239); ignored UTF7 saved state can hide an incomplete tail (CALC389/WRITER114). Secondary signature interpretation is recorded as CALC390/WRITER248 with full native backend equality explicitly unverified. All native RTL/converter algorithms and existing host admission behavior remain unchanged.

The separately human-approved S01 exception covers only the impossible rethrow of an already wrapped XmlByteError inside the private decoder catch. The decoder cannot create/receive that outer envelope; actual InputSource reads and SAX callbacks occur outside this catch. All real decode errors retain their cause and original wrapping behavior. Exact token/remapped-counter proof excludes only one zero-hit throw and one zero-hit alternative, with all8 functions and all other source positions unchanged. This is a local backend invariant, not a newly claimed upstream/native SAX defect.
omittedResponsibilities: Full libxml2/parser service, native threading/ABI, missing RTL descriptors and DOCX/XLSX model/filter/UI acceptance remain unverified.
